alt: On the night mudbank, the soaked eel boy shouts up at the hooded man, tears running, fists in the mud.
scene: Night mudbank on the White River. Worm's-eye from the mud: Gyebek as a boy, soaked, kneeling, head thrown back, mouth open in a raw shout with tears streaming; the uprooted willow a black diagonal behind him; Euija standing over him in a wet grey robe, hood gone, face in shadow, a knife in his belt. One cold moon break as the key, a sliver of Euija orange #e08a2e from a far lantern on the water.

alt: The crown prince, hood gone, holds out a hand to the boy on the mud. For once he is not laughing.
scene: Two-shot low on the mud: Euija crouched to the boy's height, one hand out, face serious for once; Gyebek looking at the hand, not yet taking it. River mist behind, the black water a flat band, the far Sabi bank dissolving into wash.

at: One step below the elders sit the crown prince’s sons.
alt: Five princes on the palace stair, each on his mother's side: a proud seventeen-year-old, a dry scorekeeper, a careful boy, a quiet twelve-year-old, an eight-year-old with a brush.
scene: Low dutch angle up a stone palace stair: five Baekje princes of different ages (17, 16, 15, 12, 8) seated one step below shadowed clan elders, each on a different side of the stair; the youngest writing on a wooden slip on his knees. The chalk-and-sand yard a pale band below. Dusk raking light.

alt: An eight-year-old prince holds a wooden slip up to the grit-grey eel boy at the bottom of the stair.
scene: Over-the-shoulder from behind Gyebek (boy, wrestling whites grey with sand): small Prince Pung on the bottom step holding up a narrow wooden slip with brushed characters (not readable). Dusk, long shadows across the sand.

alt: At the Rock of Government a sweating clerk refuses to change a number while a mapmaker scratches the river mouth into the dirt.
scene: The Assembly rock, cool morning. Sungchung, a young clerk, sweating, tide tablet clutched to his chest, facing the shadowed Satek elder; beside him Heungsu crouched, scratching a wide river mouth into packed earth with a stick. Lords as dark shapes at the edge.

alt: In the lamplit royal stable Gyebek rests his forehead against the neck of a black horse; the king in coronation silk looks away at a saddle.
scene: Royal stable at night, one oil lamp on a post. Gyebek (21) with his forehead pressed to the neck of the jet-black horse Gomanari, eyes shut, lips moving; King Euija in coronation silk in the straw behind, deliberately staring at a saddle on the wall. Lamp rakes across the horse's muscle and the silk; bokeh of a second lamp in the dark stalls.
